title: Mechanical Properties Schema
description: A schema for extracting material composition, structural info, and mechanical properties like moduli and stress/strain data.

mechanical_properties.description: A list of materials and their associated mechanical and elastic properties.

composition.description: The composition in the format Element:ratio,Element:ratio (e.g., Zr:1,O:2; Ti:0.5,Al:0.5,N:1). Do NOT leave this field empty.

space_group.description: Space group notation (e.g., P2_1/c, P4_2/nmc, Fm-3m, P6_3/mmc, R-3c)

number_of_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the unit cell (e.g., 3, 5, 8, 12). Leave empty if not mentioned

K_points.description: K-point mesh or sampling scheme (e.g., 6 9 6 9 6; 4×4×4; Monkhorst-Pack 6×6×6). Leave empty if not mentioned

theoretical_calculation_method.description: The theoretical method used (e.g., DFT, DFT+U, DFT-D, hybrid DFT). Leave empty if not mentioned

bulk_modulus.description: Bulk modulus with units (e.g., 173.8 GPa; B=150.5 GPa; K=180.2 GPa). Leave empty if not mentioned

shear_modulus.description: Shear modulus with units (e.g., 89.8 GPa; G=82.1 GPa; μ=95.3 GPa). Leave empty if not mentioned

elastic_constants.description: Elastic constants tensor components (e.g., C11=332.4, C22=307.8, C33=287.7, C44=65.9, C55=71.1, C66=108.9, C12=122.1, C13=88.3, C23=107.8). Leave empty if not mentioned

Youngs_modulus.description: Young's modulus with units (e.g., 229.9 GPa; E=213.4 GPa; Y=250.5 GPa). Leave empty if not mentioned

Poissons_ratio.description: Poisson's ratio (dimensionless) (e.g., 0.27; ν=0.26; 0.28). Leave empty if not mentioned

stacking_energy.description: Stacking fault energy with units (e.g., 50.2 mJ/m²; γ=75.3 mJ/m²). Leave empty if not mentioned

stress_strain.description: Stress–strain relationship or method (e.g., stress–strain method; uniaxial stress–strain). Leave empty if not mentioned

yield_strength.description: Yield strength with units (e.g., 450 MPa; σ_y=380 MPa). Leave empty if not mentioned

yield_stress.description: Yield stress with units (e.g., 450 MPa; τ_y=380 MPa). Leave empty if not mentioned
